ayahs.translation_bn: (হে নবী! ওয়াহীর মাধ্যমে প্রকৃত জ্ঞান ও মানসিক শক্তি দিয়ে) আমি কি তোমার বক্ষদেশকে প্রসারিত করে দেইনি?
ayahs.translation_en: Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast?
ayahs.conventional_en: Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast?
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ش-ر-ح (sh-r-ḥ): opening, expanding cognitive horizon and emotional resilience; ص-د-ر (ṣ-d-r): inner consciousness.
ayahs.conventional_bn: (হে নবী! ওয়াহীর মাধ্যমে প্রকৃত জ্ঞান ও মানসিক শক্তি দিয়ে) আমি কি তোমার বক্ষদেশকে প্রসারিত করে দেইনি?

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ش-ر-ح (sh-r-ḥ): opening, expanding cognitive horizon and emotional resilience; ص-د-ر (ṣ-d-r): inner consciousness.

english_translations.sahih_international: Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast?
english_translations.pickthall: Have We not caused thy bosom to dilate,
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Have We not expanded thee thy breast?-
english_translations.shakir: Have We not expanded for you your breast,
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), have We not comforted your heart,
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Have We not opened your breast for you (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him))?
english_translations.arberry: Did We not expand thy breast for thee

ayahs.translation_bn: আর আমি তোমার হতে সরিয়ে দিয়েছি (সমাজের অনাচার, অশ্লীলতা ও পঙ্কিলতা দেখে তোমার অন্তরে জেগে উঠা দুঃখ, বেদনা, উদ্বেগ ও অস্থিরতার) ভার,
ayahs.translation_en: And We removed from you your burden
ayahs.conventional_en: And We removed from you your burden
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root و-ض-ع (w-ḍ-'): lifting away weight; و-ز-ر (w-z-r): weighty responsibility and distress.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আর আমি তোমার হতে সরিয়ে দিয়েছি (সমাজের অনাচার, অশ্লীলতা ও পঙ্কিলতা দেখে তোমার অন্তরে জেগে উঠা দুঃখ, বেদনা, উদ্বেগ ও অস্থিরতার) ভার,

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root و-ض-ع (w-ḍ-'): lifting away weight; و-ز-ر (w-z-r): weighty responsibility and distress.

english_translations.sahih_international: And We removed from you your burden
english_translations.pickthall: And eased thee of the burden
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And removed from thee thy burden
english_translations.shakir: And taken off from you your burden,
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And removed from you your burden,
english_translations.arberry: and lift from thee thy burden,

ayahs.translation_en: Which had weighed upon your back
ayahs.conventional_en: Which had weighed upon your back
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ن-ق-ض (n-q-ḍ): creaking under excessive physical and mental strain; ظ-ه-ر (ẓ-h-r): vertebral spine.

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ن-ق-ض (n-q-ḍ): creaking under excessive physical and mental strain; ظ-ه-ر (ẓ-h-r): vertebral spine.

english_translations.sahih_international: Which had weighed upon your back
english_translations.yusuf_ali: The which did gall thy back?-
english_translations.shakir: Which pressed heavily upon your back,
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: which had been a heavy weight upon your back
english_translations.arberry: the burden that weighed down thy back?

ayahs.translation_bn: এবং আমি (মু’মিনদের যাবতীয় আবশ্যিক ‘ইবাদাত আযান, ইক্বামাত, নামায, খুৎবাহ ইত্যাদির মাধ্যমে) তোমার স্মৃতিকে উচ্চ মর্যাদায় তুলে ধরেছি।
ayahs.translation_en: And raised high for you your repute.
ayahs.conventional_en: And raised high for you your repute.
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ر-ف-ع (r-f-'): elevated ontological rank; ذ-ك-ر (dh-k-r): enduring commemoration across time and space.
ayahs.conventional_bn: এবং আমি (মু’মিনদের যাবতীয় আবশ্যিক ‘ইবাদাত আযান, ইক্বামাত, নামায, খুৎবাহ ইত্যাদির মাধ্যমে) তোমার স্মৃতিকে উচ্চ মর্যাদায় তুলে ধরেছি।

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ر-ف-ع (r-f-'): elevated ontological rank; ذ-ك-ر (dh-k-r): enduring commemoration across time and space.

english_translations.sahih_international: And raised high for you your repute.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And raised high the esteem (in which) thou (art held)?
english_translations.shakir: And exalted for you your esteem?
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: and granted you an exalted reputation?
english_translations.arberry: Did We not exalt thy fame?

ayahs.translation_en: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
ayahs.conventional_en: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ع-س-ر ('-s-r): difficult constraint; ي-س-ر (y-s-r): ease; physical law of homeostatic rebalancing.

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ع-س-ر ('-s-r): difficult constraint; ي-س-ر (y-s-r): ease; physical law of homeostatic rebalancing.

english_translations.sahih_international: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
english_translations.pickthall: But lo! with hardship goeth ease,
english_translations.yusuf_ali: So, verily, with every difficulty, there is relief:
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: After every difficulty there is relief.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: So verily, with the hardship, there is relief,
english_translations.arberry: So truly with hardship comes ease,

ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Cognitive reinforcement demonstrating that relief is mathematically paired with the hardship itself.

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Cognitive reinforcement demonstrating that relief is mathematically paired with the hardship itself.

english_translations.yusuf_ali: Verily, with every difficulty there is relief.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Certainly, after every difficulty there comes relief.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Verily, with the hardship, there is relief (i.e. there is one hardship with two reliefs, so one hardship cannot overcome two reliefs).

ayahs.translation_bn: কাজেই তুমি যখনই অবসর পাবে, ‘ইবাদাতের কঠোর শ্রমে লেগে যাবে,
ayahs.translation_en: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].
ayahs.conventional_en: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].
ayahs.meta_bn: প্রসেস ক্লোজিং ও নেক্সট লুপ ট্রিগারিং
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ف-ر-غ (f-r-gh): concluding a phase; ن-ص-ب (n-ṣ-b): proactive, disciplined exertion without stagnation.
ayahs.conventional_bn: কাজেই তুমি যখনই অবসর পাবে, ‘ইবাদাতের কঠোর শ্রমে লেগে যাবে,

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ف-ر-غ (f-r-gh): concluding a phase; ن-ص-ب (n-ṣ-b): proactive, disciplined exertion without stagnation.

english_translations.sahih_international: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].
english_translations.pickthall: So when thou art relieved, still toil
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Therefore, when thou art free (from thine immediate task), still labour hard,
english_translations.shakir: So when you are free, nominate.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: When you are free from (your obligations), strive hard (to worship God)
english_translations.mohsin_khan: So when you have finished (from your occupation), then stand up for Allah's worship (i.e. stand up for prayer).
english_translations.arberry: So when thou art empty, labour,

ayahs.translation_bn: এবং তোমার রব-এর প্রতি গভীরভাবে মনোযোগ দিবে।
ayahs.translation_en: And to your Lord direct [your] longing.
ayahs.conventional_en: And to your Lord direct [your] longing.
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ر-غ-ب (r-gh-b): single-minded devotion directed towards the Source of all existence.
ayahs.conventional_bn: এবং তোমার রব-এর প্রতি গভীরভাবে মনোযোগ দিবে।

metadata.lexicon_modern_notes: Root ر-غ-ب (r-gh-b): single-minded devotion directed towards the Source of all existence.

english_translations.sahih_international: And to your Lord direct [your] longing.
english_translations.pickthall: And strive to please thy Lord.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And to thy Lord turn (all) thy attention.
english_translations.shakir: And make your Lord your exclusive object.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: and be devoted to your Lord's service.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And to your Lord (Alone) turn (all your intentions and hopes and) your invocations.
english_translations.arberry: and let thy Lord be thy Quest.
